title: Native SandboxRequirements v1 (requirement != observation)
x-notes: requires.* = hard preconditions (rejected pre-create with HOST_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE when unmet)
resources.* = observations/requests, canonical integer units (bytes / cpu_millis / pids), no bool-as-number
secrets MUST NOT enter argv/command (LSR-1, docs/security/SECRET_HANDLING.md)

single_id_compatibility_policy.description: STRICT refuses unfaithful UID/GID expressions pre-create; FLATTEN_ROOT is an explicit benchmark-compat switch whose effects MUST appear in effective_degradations

resources.description: observations/requests only; hardness comes from requires.*, never from setting a number
